$comment: SealLink v1.0 Cryptographic Algorithm Registry (SPEC-00 §5, SPEC-01 §4). Embodies algorithmic neutrality: minimal MTI core for global interoperability plus equal-footing optional modules for national and post-quantum suites.
governance: Registry Update for reserved-slot/metadata registration; Optional Module SLIP + versioned schema extension for active wire algorithms; Core SLIP for MTI changes (SPEC-00 §5)

algorithms.wire_encoding: Lowercase hex; omitted as default in ThresholdPolicy / DeviceThresholdPolicy / grant.recipient(key) for canonical single encoding (SL-WIRE-013).

algorithms.standard: SEC 1 / FIPS 186-5 ECDSA over NIST P-256 (strict low-S raw r||s)
algorithms.wire_encoding: Compressed 33-byte SEC 1 public key; 64-byte raw low-S signature.

algorithms.standard: RFC 8032 Ed25519 (strict canonical R/S, cofactorless [S]B == R + [k]A, non-small-order A/R rejection)
OpenSSH PROTOCOL.sshsig deterministic wrapper (namespace='seallink-v1', reserved='', hash_alg='sha512') over strict RFC 8032 Ed25519
algorithms.wire_encoding: 32-byte non-small-order Ed25519 public key; 64-byte raw Ed25519 signature over SSHSIG preimage of SHA-512(signing_digest).

algorithms.standard: W3C WebAuthn / CTAP2 hardware wrapper (rpIdHash + UP/UV flags + clientDataJSON challenge=base64url(signing_digest)) over strict low-S NIST P-256 ECDSA
algorithms.wire_encoding: Compressed 33-byte SEC 1 P-256 public key + policy rp_id; 64-byte low-S r||s signature paired with authenticator_data_hex and client_data_hex.

algorithms.standard: W3C WebAuthn / CTAP2 hardware wrapper (rpIdHash + UP/UV flags + clientDataJSON challenge=base64url(signing_digest)) over strict RFC 8032 Ed25519
algorithms.wire_encoding: 32-byte non-small-order Ed25519 public key + policy rp_id; 64-byte Ed25519 signature paired with authenticator_data_hex and client_data_hex.

algorithms.standard: BIP-66 strict DER ECDSA over secp256k1 (accepting high-S per Namecoin Core nc28.0 consensus)
algorithms.wire_encoding: Namecoin native SegWit v0 witness stack (P2WPKH / P2WSH).
40 lowercase hex characters (P2WPKH witness program / OP_NAME_NEW commitment).

algorithms.standard: RFC 7748 X25519 Curve25519 Diffie-Hellman (rejecting all 12 RFC 7748 low-order u-coordinates)
algorithms.wire_encoding: 64 lowercase hex characters in transport-binding statements.
64 lowercase hex characters in manifest.service, mirror_endpoints, and transport-binding.

algorithms.standard: RFC 9580 OpenPGP v6 32-byte SHA-256 primary key fingerprint
algorithms.wire_encoding: 64 lowercase hex characters in transport-binding statements.

algorithms.standard: Hybrid BIP-340 + FIPS 204 ML-DSA-65 composite signature
